clue.text: Replace one weak link with another? Such waste

definitions.text: Replace one weak link with another?
definitions.meaning: a fuse is the deliberately weak link in a circuit, so swapping in a new one is to fuse again

explanation.definitionFit: Read as two parts, the word means to fit an electrical fuse once more, and as a noun it means household rubbish.

clue.text: A dressing down for salesman heading for the top

parts.note: a rep is a sales representative
the roof is the top of a house

explanation.surface: A sales rep gets a telling-off as he heads for the top job.
explanation.walkthrough: 'heading for' only joins the salesman to the top.
explanation.definitionFit: A rebuke or scolding is what a dressing down is, a sharp verbal telling-off.

clue.text: Partisan is crushed in a final act

indicators.note: crushed suggests the letters are squashed out of shape and rearranged

explanation.surface: A party supporter is overwhelmed in the closing scene of a drama.
explanation.definitionFit: A zealous, one-sided supporter is both partisan and fanatical, so the adjectives are synonyms.

clue.text: Companion of Snow White likely to crash?

definitions.meaning: one of the seven dwarfs in the fairy tale is named for drowsiness
to crash is slang for falling asleep, so a drowsy person is likely to crash

explanation.definitionFit: One of the seven dwarfs is named Sleepy, and someone drowsy is ready to crash, slang for nodding off.

clue.text: Criticise article about Roman building

parts.note: to pan is to criticise harshly
the is the definite article
on means about, as in a talk on a subject

explanation.surface: Someone finds fault with a magazine piece about an ancient Roman structure.
explanation.definitionFit: The temple to all the gods in Rome, still standing, is the famous domed building of that name.

clue.text: A grating not fully closed

parts.note: a jar is a harsh, grating sound or jolt

explanation.surface: A metal grille that has been left slightly open.
explanation.walkthrough: 'grating' looks like a noun for a grille, but it means a jarring sound.
explanation.definitionFit: A door left slightly open is described as standing open a little, which is the idiom for not shut.

clue.text: I am caught in the actual crime

indicators.note: the speaker says they are caught inside something, so the letter goes into the phrase

parts.note: the very means the actual, as in the very thing

explanation.surface: A confession: I was caught in the act of committing the crime.
explanation.definitionFit: Stealing is a crime, and the word names the act or practice of theft.

clue.text: Chemical they left brewing

indicators.note: brewing stirs things up, so the letters are mixed

explanation.surface: Some people left a chemical concoction bubbling away.
explanation.definitionFit: The radical found in ethanol is a chemical group, hence a chemical term.

clue.text: He must have a supporter and may get one in me

indicators.note: may get suggests the letters can be got into a new order

explanation.surface: A candidate needs backing, and might find a backer in the speaker.
explanation.walkthrough: 'may get' rearranges ONE IN ME. A candidate put forward for election needs a seconder, a supporter.
explanation.definitionFit: A candidate formally proposed for a post needs a seconder, someone who supports the proposal.

clue.text: Craftsman who takes a gamble

definitions.meaning: read as a man in a craft, someone propelling a flat boat with a pole
in British slang a gambler or customer is called a ...

explanation.definitionFit: Someone poling a flat boat on a river is one sense; a better at the bookmaker's is the British slang sense.

clue.text: Amateur bandsman?

parts.note: not a musician in a band but a hobbyist who broadcasts on radio frequency bands

explanation.definitionFit: A hobbyist who transmits on short-wave frequency bands is an amateur operator, playfully called a bandsman.

clue.text: Partners who dance up in close formation

indicators.note: formation suggests the letters are arranged into a new shape, like dancers moving into position

explanation.surface: Dance partners moving up close together in a formation dance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'formation' rearranges UP with CLOSE; 'in' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Pairs on a dance floor are referred to as twosomes, each pair of partners being one.

clue.text: Top note I struggled to get, stretching high

indicators.note: struggled suggests the words are wrestled into a different order

explanation.surface: A singer strains to reach a high note at the top of their range.
explanation.definitionFit: Standing on the balls of the feet is how one reaches high, so the phrase means stretching up.

clue.text: Name evenly distributed among girls and boys

definitions.text: Name evenly distributed among girls and boys

indicators.note: distributed suggests the letters are shared out into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A first name used equally for daughters and sons.
explanation.walkthrough: 'distributed' rearranges EVENLY. The whole clue is also the definition: this forename has been given to both sexes, such as the novelist Waugh and the diarist.
explanation.definitionFit: A forename borne by men such as the author Waugh and by women alike is unisex, shared by both sexes.

clue.text: Cut off, making one extremely behind schedule

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one
so means very or extremely
late means behind schedule

explanation.surface: Being cut off made someone run very late.
explanation.definitionFit: To separate or quarantine something is to cut it off from others.

clue.text: Withdrawal of 101 meeting points

indicators.note: a withdrawal is a drawing back, so the word next to it is read backwards

parts.note: CI is 101 in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: Withdrawing from a hundred and one places where people gather.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Withdrawal' turns the clue word 'of' round to make FO.
explanation.definitionFit: Points where lines or rays converge are focal points, the plural of focus.

clue.text: Punctuation mark perhaps too freely used

indicators.note: freely used suggests the letters are handled loosely and reordered

explanation.surface: A punctuation mark that is perhaps scattered about too liberally.
explanation.definitionFit: The raised comma marking possession or omission is a punctuation mark, often misused in shop signs.

clue.text: Has to step out — fast!

indicators.note: out suggests the letters are put out of order

explanation.surface: Someone is told to step outside at once.
explanation.definitionFit: Doing something with great speed is doing it in haste, an old phrase meaning very quickly.

clue.text: It keeps food warm when transfer ring to the lap

indicators.note: transfer suggests the letters are moved about into a new order

explanation.surface: A warming dish is moved from the cooker ring onto someone's lap.
explanation.walkthrough: 'transfer' rearranges TO THE LAP; 'when' and 'ring' are links, though a cooker ring is itself this appliance.
explanation.definitionFit: A heated metal plate or cooker ring is used to keep dishes warm before serving.

clue.text: Fish-woman a source of bad feeling

parts.note: a salmon is a fish
Ella is a woman's name

explanation.surface: A fishwife is the cause of some ill feeling.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bad feeling' sounds like resentment but means feeling ill.
explanation.definitionFit: The bacterium causes food poisoning, so it is a source of feeling unwell.

clue.text: Snarled about a false report

indicators.note: about suggests the letters are turned around and rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone growled out a lie about another person.
explanation.definitionFit: A spoken defamatory statement is a false report that damages someone's reputation.

clue.text: Employer provides a course in the city

indicators.note: in places one piece inside the other

parts.note: Ur is the ancient city in Mesopotamia, a crossword stock city
SE, south-east, is a compass course

explanation.surface: A business offers a training course in town.
explanation.walkthrough: 'course' looks like training, but it is a compass bearing.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who employs a tool or resource makes use of it, so an employer here is one who uses.

clue.text: Book store

definitions.meaning: to book is to arrange a place in advance
a store is a supply kept back for later

explanation.definitionFit: To book a table is to secure it ahead, and a store is a supply held back for future need.

clue.text: Mass of people moving about in the road in the morning

parts.note: ST is the abbreviation for street
re means about or concerning
AM is ante meridiem, the morning

explanation.surface: Crowds are moving around in the street early in the day.
explanation.definitionFit: A steady flow of people moving in one direction is a stream, like a flowing river.

clue.text: Believe one wouldn't say no to this

definitions.meaning: to believe an explanation is to take it as true

definitions.text: one wouldn't say no to this
definitions.meaning: a refusal is saying no, so the opposite is to take what is offered

explanation.definitionFit: To accept a story is to believe it, and to accept an offer is the opposite of refusing it.

clue.text: French writer quietly exits the academic field

indicators.note: exits means a letter leaves the word for the grounds

parts.note: a campus is the grounds of a university
P is piano, the musical direction for quietly

explanation.surface: A French author slips away silently from the university.
explanation.definitionFit: Albert, the author of The Outsider and The Plague, was a French novelist and Nobel laureate.

clue.text: They join together in operations

parts.note: the things that close a wound by sewing after surgery

explanation.definitionFit: Surgeons close wounds with sutures, the loops of thread that hold tissue together.

clue.text: Put on about a pound

indicators.note: about means the outer word goes round the other

parts.note: to put money on a horse is to bet

explanation.surface: Someone gains a pound or so in weight.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Put on' suggests gaining weight, but it means wagering.
explanation.definitionFit: To pound something is to strike it repeatedly, which is to hit or batter it.

clue.text: Intend to go into action despite loss of rank

definitions.note: a noun phrase standing for a participle meaning lowered in status

indicators.note: to go into means the word is placed inside another

parts.note: a deed is an action
to mean is to intend

explanation.surface: Someone means to take action even though they have been demoted.
explanation.walkthrough: 'despite' is only a link; the definition is loosely phrased as a noun.
explanation.definitionFit: To be degraded or lowered in standing is to suffer a drop in status or dignity.

clue.text: An exceptional warm spring

parts.note: not a mild season but a natural hot fountain shooting from the ground

explanation.definitionFit: A hot spring that periodically spouts water and steam, like Old Faithful, is a natural feature of volcanic regions.

clue.text: As a pre-Raphaelite he pledged himself to resist change

indicators.note: change means the letters are altered into a new order

explanation.surface: A member of a Victorian artistic brotherhood swore to resist change.
explanation.walkthrough: 'change' rearranges TO RESIST. 'As' and 'he pledged himself' are links: the Brotherhood's members pledged themselves to its aims.
explanation.definitionFit: Dante Gabriel, poet and painter, was a founder of the Victorian brotherhood of painters.

clue.text: Word in current usage

parts.note: not a fashionable term but a unit used in measuring electric current

explanation.definitionFit: The SI unit of electric current is named after a French physicist, a term used in electrical measurement.
